payload.prompt: Put these first-run setup steps in the right order.

items.label: Scan hardware
items.detail: Detect GPU, VRAM, CPU.

items.label: Pick a tier
items.detail: High / Mid / Low based on what the scan found.

items.label: Download the preset's models
items.detail: Pull GGUFs + embedders from Hugging Face.

items.label: Assign models to slots
items.detail: Symlink each downloaded file into its slot folder.

items.label: Test first inference
items.detail: Send a hello-world prompt; confirm the brain answers.

payload.prompt: Put these debugging steps in the right order.

items.label: Verify the fix in the same conditions
Resolve the slot's symlink
items.detail: {userdata}/slots/{id}/model.gguf → registry file.

items.label: Read GGUF metadata
items.detail: Architecture, vocab, quant — without loading weights.

items.label: Pick the right backend
items.detail: Burn for embedders, llama.cpp for chat brains, Candle for vision.

items.label: Boot the engine
items.detail: Allocate context, build sampler, mmap weights.

items.label: Run a warm-up forward pass
items.detail: Confirm the model produces sane logits before announcing READY.

payload.prompt: Order a single chat turn from input to rendered reply.

items.label: Minion embeds the message
items.detail: Burn + Harrier 0.6B produces a 384-dim vector.

items.label: Retrieve relevant memories
items.detail: Qdrant ANN search against stored embeddings.

items.label: Assemble brain context
items.detail: Recent turns + retrieved memories + system prompt.

items.label: Brain generates tokens
items.detail: llama.cpp streams logits one token at a time.

payload.prompt: Put the platform boot phases in order.

items.label: Bootstrap log + crash safety
items.detail: Pre-logger panic hook + stderr redirect.

items.label: Bring up Layer-1 services
items.detail: libSQL, DuckDB, SurrealKV, Moka, Vector store.

items.label: Scan model registry + restore slot assignments
Precompute RRO sidecar archive
items.detail: rkyv-archived text + embedding + 1-hop neighbors for zero-copy reads.

payload.prompt: Order the wizard phases as the customer experiences them.

items.label: Welcome
items.detail: Greeting + Let's Go.

items.label: Hardware
items.detail: GPU + VRAM detection.

items.label: Preset
items.detail: Tier-locked preset picker.

items.label: Cortex tiles
items.detail: Five anatomy tiles — Eyes / Ears / Mouth / Sparkles / Brain.

items.label: Installing
items.detail: Per-slot model downloads.

items.label: Clyffy Collab
items.detail: Optional Anthropic API key + Claude Code detect.

items.label: Complete
items.detail: Open chat or close overlay.

payload.prompt: A model fails to load. Order the recovery steps.

items.label: Scope the failure
items.detail: One slot or all slots? One model or many?

items.label: Verify the symlink target file exists and is the expected size
Re-read the GGUF metadata via the diagnostic CLI
Try swapping backends
items.detail: If llama.cpp fails on this file, try mistral.rs (if model is multimodal).

items.label: If still failing, re-download the model
If still failing, capture logs + crash JSON for an issue report
